title: Predict: Integer vs Floating Division
hints: Integer `/` truncates toward zero; `%` takes the sign of the left operand.
jsBridge: `7 / 2` is `3` in Swift (Int) but `3.5` in JS. `7 % -2` keeps the dividend's sign in both languages. Mixing `Int` and `Double` needs explicit conversion, so these surprises are always visible in the types.
